mapping.text_collation: NOCASE on canonical TEXT columns; ASCII folding, not full ACE locale equivalence
mapping.report_path: Python report exports are canonical for SQLite; Access rpt_* SQL is backend-specific

tables.name: account
tables.purpose: One financial account: opening balance, currency, ownership and account class.

checks.name: ck_account_kind
checks.expression: kind IN ('asset','liability')

checks.name: ck_account_open_int
checks.expression: opening_balance_minor = Int(opening_balance_minor)

tables.name: category
tables.purpose: Income/expense classifications, with an optional parent category.

checks.name: ck_category_kind
checks.expression: category_kind IN ('income','expense','interest','fee')

tables.name: import_batch
tables.purpose: One source file for one account; its hash prevents silent repeated imports.

tables.name: staging_row
tables.purpose: One raw/parsed source row, proposed splits, duplicate decision and human review state.

checks.name: ck_staging_parsed_amount_int
checks.expression: parsed_amount_minor IS NULL OR parsed_amount_minor = Int(parsed_amount_minor)

tables.name: ledger_txn
tables.purpose: One signed posted transaction. Retains source provenance or a reversal reference.

checks.name: ck_txn_amount_int
checks.expression: amount_minor = Int(amount_minor)

tables.name: transfer_link
tables.purpose: Pairs an outgoing and incoming ledger transaction for a transfer between accounts.

tables.name: split
tables.purpose: Allocates a transaction amount among categories, transfers or adjustments.

checks.name: ck_split_kind
checks.expression: split_kind IN ('category','transfer','adjustment')

checks.name: ck_split_amount_int
checks.expression: amount_minor IS NULL OR amount_minor = Int(amount_minor)

tables.name: statement
tables.purpose: Dated statement totals for one account, with an opaque external evidence reference.

checks.name: ck_statement_opening_balance_int
checks.expression: opening_balance_minor IS NULL OR opening_balance_minor = Int(opening_balance_minor)

checks.name: ck_statement_closing_balance_int
checks.expression: closing_balance_minor IS NULL OR closing_balance_minor = Int(closing_balance_minor)

checks.name: ck_statement_minimum_due_int
checks.expression: minimum_due_minor IS NULL OR minimum_due_minor = Int(minimum_due_minor)

checks.name: ck_statement_interest_charged_int
checks.expression: interest_charged_minor IS NULL OR interest_charged_minor = Int(interest_charged_minor)

checks.name: ck_statement_fees_charged_int
checks.expression: fees_charged_minor IS NULL OR fees_charged_minor = Int(fees_charged_minor)

tables.name: statement_bucket_balance
tables.purpose: One balance per statement and APR bucket identifier.

checks.name: ck_sbb_balance_int
checks.expression: balance_minor IS NULL OR balance_minor = Int(balance_minor)

tables.name: statement_payment
tables.purpose: Allocates some of a payment transaction to a particular statement.

checks.name: ck_sp_amount_int
checks.expression: amount_minor IS NULL OR amount_minor = Int(amount_minor)

tables.name: reconciliation
tables.purpose: A statement comparison, its remaining difference and review status.

checks.name: ck_recon_difference_int
checks.expression: difference_minor IS NULL OR difference_minor = Int(difference_minor)

tables.name: reconciliation_item
tables.purpose: Associates each included transaction with a reconciliation.

tables.name: card_terms
tables.purpose: Effective-dated credit limit and minimum-payment rule for a card account.

checks.name: ck_terms_credit_limit_int
checks.expression: credit_limit_minor IS NULL OR credit_limit_minor = Int(credit_limit_minor)

checks.name: ck_terms_min_amount_int
checks.expression: min_amount_minor IS NULL OR min_amount_minor = Int(min_amount_minor)

checks.name: ck_terms_min_floor_int
checks.expression: min_floor_minor IS NULL OR min_floor_minor = Int(min_floor_minor)

tables.name: card_apr_bucket
tables.purpose: APR and promotional/deferred-interest terms for each bucket in a terms record.

tables.name: asset_valuation
tables.purpose: A dated asset estimate, its source/method and optional cost basis.

checks.name: ck_valuation_value_int
checks.expression: value_minor IS NULL OR value_minor = Int(value_minor)

checks.name: ck_valuation_cost_basis_int
checks.expression: cost_basis_minor IS NULL OR cost_basis_minor = Int(cost_basis_minor)

tables.name: command_log
tables.purpose: Accepted command/result documents supporting idempotent replay and saved scenario payloads.

tables.name: audit_log
tables.purpose: Before/after images of changed entities, linked to their accepted command.

tables.name: contract_meta
tables.purpose: Schema/contract/backend versions, configuration and saved-scenario command pointers.

logical_relationships.note: Import provenance. source_batch_id has a physical FK; this composite source-row link is repository-managed.
Duplicate-match evidence; no SQL foreign key is declared.
Polymorphic reference to the changed entity; retained after an entity is removed, so it is not a SQL FK.
Only meta_key values beginning scenario: point to saved payoff commands; ordinary metadata values do not.
